thread:
lisa: Heads-up — we need an activation dependency matrix + demo creds for the AWS/GCP/Azure listing for Redwood Core. Who can own the matrix? Target: EOD Thu.

raj: I can take the matrix. Will need a checklist of artifacts per cloud (AMI/VM image, service account, billing SKU, trial flags). cc @sofia @emma

sofia: I’ll own demo creds + sandbox. Quick Q: do we want scoped demo users or full feature trial accounts? Also need publisher portal access.

emma: Legal will compile the minimal checklist: export controls, EULA localization, data handling note. Also confirm whether demo uses prod-like data or synthetic only.

clayton: Packaging note — we should present 2 SKUs: Hosted API (metered) and Dedicated (reserved). Trial model: 14-day hosted trial with fixed token quota. I'll add a proposed pricing snippet in the doc. https://redwood.internal/docs/marketplace-packaging (placeholder)

lisa: Raj — include infra/dependency columns (required AMI/region, infra limits, kernel compat). Sofia — include a short runbook for credential rotation and credential placement (1Password entry).

sofia: Draft runbook snippet:
```bash
# rotate demo creds
aws iam create-access-key --user demo-marketplace
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create key.json --iam-account=demo@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
az ad sp credential reset --name demo-app
```
sofia: I also need partnerships to approve publisher email so I can request publisher portal invite. marketplace-bot: Publisher portal invite link sent at 11:02 — https://marketplace.aws.amazon.com/pub/invite/ABCD

raj: Uploaded first draft matrix to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abc — columns: cloud, region, AMI/AMI-id, service-account, sample-credentials, trial-flag, billing-sku, packaging-notes, ops-runbook. Filling AMI/GCP image ids next.

emma: Legal Q: do we require localized EULAs for EU/UK marketplace listings? If so, I’ll loop in intl-legal and localization.

clayton: Yes — require EU/UK localized EULA for Azure and some GCP regions. Also recommend listing copy mention "data never leaves customer region" for dedicated.

lisa: Timeline recap: EOD Thu — matrix draft. Fri AM — demo creds & sandbox ready. Fri EOD — legal sign-off (if no major issues). If anyone sees blockers, flag here. :thumbsup:

sofia: I'll spin up the sandbox and post credentials into 1Password (shared collection). tagging @security for credential policy.

security: Please use 1Password collection name "partners-demo". Set credential expiration = 7 days and enable one-time-view where possible. Add an ACL entry for partnerships+platform.

marketplace-bot: Publisher portal status: offer draft created (offer-id: rfwd-core-2024). Link: https://marketplace.aws.amazon.com/offer/rfwd-core-2024

raj: Added kernel/quantization notes column for each SKU. Need input from eng-runtime on latency SLOs and recommended batch/quant profiles per SKU. @nate-runtime can you confirm?

nate-runtime: Yep — will add latency targets and suggested quant/batch profiles by EOD today. Will include recommended CPU/GPU SKU mappings and a short note on prefix caching for chat workloads.

lisa: Great. Marketing — we’ll need hero screenshots + 60s video next week. Need staging keys to record calls.

marketing: Noted. Will schedule a recording slot once Sofia confirms sandbox endpoints and short-term creds.

lisa: Thanks all — next steps: Raj finalize matrix, Sofia publish demo-creds to 1P, Emma escalate localization if needed, Nate add runtime notes, Clayton finalize SKU labels. Ping here if any blocker.

sofia: On it. Will post 1P link when ready.

clayton: +1.

emma: +1 — looping intl-legal as needed.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: publisher invite expires in 72h.

lisa: Closing loop for now. Appreciate the quick turn.
